description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 27.07.2020 to 02.08.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and other charges are to be calculated based on currency exchange rates. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it establishes compliance requirements for import/export transactions and formally rescinds previous regulations.
